completionAndCancellation.coreSourceFindings: Version0.6.6createClipboard tracks active operation AbortControllers. all-available starts host work and dispatches the terminal synchronously before awaiting host; remote terminals suppress host writes unless explicitly allowed. A pre-aborted core signal attempts neither route, but the TUI adapter does not expose/pass that signal. dispose marks unusable, aborts active operations, awaits their settled promises and then disposes the host. Host wrapper likewise tracks/awaits backend operations. Cancellation is cooperative and cannot interrupt an already-blocked synchronous platform call. Terminal attempted is expressly only synchronous local dispatch, not verified delivery. A prior terminal attempt may therefore coexist with a later hostcancelled result and satisfy the TUI's success condition.
